description: One reader for the official datasets outside the headline indicators. `family` picks the set: financial_prices (government yield curves, securities, overnight benchmarks; by currency), native_history (gold ownership and custody, Treasury auctions, cash and debt, TIC positions, EIA energy; by source and year), official_dataset (balance of payments, international investment position, capital flows, central-bank liquidity, FX intervention, auctions, external debt, credit conditions, wage settlements; by dataset and currency) and company_results (company trading updates as macro evidence; by country). Omit the selector to list what a family holds. Requires an API key. Access: USD is available without an API key; every other currency returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

country.description: company_results only: two-letter ISO country code. Omit to list countries.

currency.description: 3-letter currency code for financial_prices and official_dataset.

dataset.description: official_dataset only: the dataset slug, for example bop or cb_liquidity.

filters.description: Family-specific filters. financial_prices: measure, instrument_id, issuer. native_history: measure, holder_country_code, ownership_basis, maturity, account_type, order, region, product. official_dataset: component (bop only). company_results: industry, company, measure, order.

source.description: financial_prices or native_history: the source id. Omit on native_history to list sources.

year.description: native_history only: the year to read.

name: official_datasets
title: Official Datasets
